name: unfollow-guard
description: Unfollow Guard: a Chromium extension to see who doesn't follow you back on Instagram & Facebook and unfollow them safely.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/build-test.mjs && python3 scripts/build.py
scripts.screenshots: npm run build:test && node scripts/screenshots/shoot.js && python3 scripts/screenshots/make-gif.py
